board_retention: Use edge rails or low-profile clips after the final fabrication STEP; do not assume mounting holes.

power.input: USB 5 V bus power through the XIAO ESP32S3 onboard USB-C receptacle
power.backlight_rail: USB VBUS through 27 Ohm, 0.25 W series resistor

mcu_module.mounting: castellated module soldered to carrier PCB
mcu_module.usb_c: onboard receptacle aligned to right enclosure edge

ports.validation: Measure final cutout, insertion direction and plug envelope from the verified XIAO STEP before enclosure release.

ports.owner: ZTS6216 bottom port through carrier PCB
ports.validation: Seal the short PCB-to-enclosure acoustic path; keep solder paste out of the sound hole.

interactive_elements.orientation: long axis parallel to 85.6 mm product width

display_interface.connector: HCTL HC-FPC-05-09-8RLTAG / C5213749, dual-side contacts, 0.5 mm pitch, 0.3 mm FPC, 1.0 mm board height, bottom-side placement at left edge
display_interface.reset: 10 kOhm pull-up to 3.3 V plus 100 nF to ground
display_interface.backlight: VBUS through 27 Ohm 1% 0.25 W; no dimming in revision 1

microphone_interface.output: analog OUT pin, 100 Ohm nominal source impedance, approximately 0.9 V DC output at 1.5 V supply per datasheet
microphone_interface.preamplifier: AC-coupled non-inverting TLV9061 biased at 1.65 V, nominal gain 101 V/V using 100 kOhm feedback and 1 kOhm gain leg
microphone_interface.antialias_filter: 1 kOhm series plus 10 nF to ground at ADC input, nominal 15.9 kHz pole
microphone_interface.decoupling: 100 nF X7R at ZTS6216 and TLV9061 VDD pins; 1 uF on the 1.65 V virtual-ground node
microphone_interface.land_pattern: 1:1 to 2.75 x 1.85 mm package pads; 0.50 mm bottom acoustic port; no solder paste over port

firmware_constraints: Use Espressif TinyUSB-based USB UAC device support on ESP32-S3 and compose it with HID keyboard functionality.
Target mono 48 kHz, 16-bit capture unless firmware validation demonstrates a more compatible rate.
Implement one mechanical key as microphone mute and mirror the effective mute state on the display.
Do not enable Wi-Fi/BLE in the default firmware unless needed; reduced RF activity lowers current and interference risk.
assembly_constraints: Keep the XIAO antenna end free of carrier-PCB copper and enclosure metal according to vendor guidance.
Keep LCD/backlight and USB current paths away from MIC1, U2, the 1.65 V bias node and the analog ADC trace.
Place J1 on the bottom-left edge with its cable opening facing left; the display tail wraps around the left PCB edge without a sharp fold.
Use dual-side-contact J1 (HC-FPC-05-09-8RLTAG / C5213749); it accepts the confirmed front-contact display tail after the tail wraps around the left PCB edge.
Place the XIAO ESP32S3 on the bottom-right with its onboard USB-C receptacle facing the right edge; do not add a second host USB connector.
Place MIC1 at the top edge directly over the PCB sound cutout and use a sealed short path to the enclosure opening.
Use four centered 19 mm-pitch MX-compatible CPG151101D05 red switches with bottom-side CPG151101S11-16 / C41430893 hot-swap sockets.
Keep the hot-swap socket bodies and SMD pads on the bottom/service side and the removable switches/keycaps on the top/user side.
Place the key row low enough to use the lower board area while retaining at least 4 mm nominal keycap-to-board-edge margin.

risks.item: Analog microphone uses the ESP32-S3 internal ADC
risks.mitigation: Prototype-validate noise, gain, clipping and 48 kHz DMA capture; two spare GPIOs remain after the change.
Use red linear switches, isolate the acoustic path, place MIC1 away from switch bodies, and validate key-noise pickup on prototype.

risks.item: Resistor-fed backlight brightness varies with USB and LED voltage
risks.mitigation: Current remains below the panel maximum; qualify visual uniformity on prototype before considering a constant-current revision.

risks.item: MX switch and keycap stack supersedes the previous 18 mm enclosure-height target
risks.mitigation: Use the revised 28 mm provisional outer-height limit and verify the exact installed CPG151101D05 plus chosen MX keycap stack during enclosure CAD.

risks.item: The published PCB release still uses the superseded C2992524 J1 footprint
risks.mitigation: Replace J1 with jlcpcb:C5213749, re-verify native footprint chirality, cable-opening direction and pin 1, then reroute, run KiCad DRC, inspect previews and publish a new release before fabrication.
